address: House of Tan Yeok Nee, #02-01, 101 Penang Road, 238466, Singapore
bio: In this restaurant in a restored heritage building, original vintage architectural features meet subtle wabi-sabi touches to great effect. The single tasting menu, which reflects the chef's Japanese background, demonstrates precision and meticulous layering of flavours. His balanced abalone chawanmushi is testament to a deft control of heat. Served tableside, the pan-fried isaki fish in Nyonya beurre blanc is prepared with aplomb.
